programs.name: Veterans and Surviving Spouses Property Tax Credit

ratingRequired.correct: 100% schedular (38 USC 1114/1134) OR 100% IU; permanence not required
ratingRequired.quote: Has either a service-connected disability rating of 100 percent under 38 USC 1114 or 1134 or a 100 percent disability rating based on individual unemployability.
ratingRequired.note: details text 'Requires 100% T&P or IU rating' should read '100% schedular or IU'; WDVA denies the credit for any year the rating lapsed for part of the year.

residency.current: entered active duty as a WI resident OR lived in WI 5 consecutive years after entering active duty, and currently reside in WI
residency.quote: Was a resident of this state at the time of entry into that active service or had been a resident of this state for any consecutive 5-year period after entry into that service.
residency.note: Plus 71.07(6e)(a)3.c: 'Is currently a resident of this state for purposes of receiving veterans benefits under ch. 45.' Resolves the brief's lead; the file's wording is right.

survivingSpouse.quote: and following the individual's death, his or her spouse began to receive, and continues to receive, dependency and indemnity compensation, as defined in 38 USC 101 (14).
survivingSpouse.note: Four survivor routes: died on active duty as WI resident; WI resident at death with 100%/IU; Guard/reserve line-of-duty training death; or spouse receives DIC. Unremarried only.

type / acreage.correct: refundable credit for 100% of property taxes on the principal dwelling and up to one acre
type / acreage.quote: "Property taxes" means real property taxes, exclusive of special assessments, delinquent interest, and charges for service, paid by a claimant ... on the eligible veteran's or unremarried surviving spouse's principal dwelling in this state during the taxable year

programs.effectiveChanges: None for TY2026/TY2027. Claimed on Form 1 (line 34 for 2025) within four years of the return's unextended due date (71.75(2)); one-time WDVA certification (Form WDVA 2097).
programs.note: Income-tax credit mechanics: pay the bill, claim 100% back on the Wisconsin return.

jurisdictionNote.note: Accurate. Optional precision: 'entered service as a WI resident or any consecutive 5-year WI residency after entry, and currently a WI resident'.

summary: Wisconsin's refundable credit for 100% of property taxes on the principal dwelling (up to one acre) at a 100% schedular or IU rating is confirmed, including the residency gate (WI resident at entry or any consecutive 5 years after entry, and currently resident) and the four survivor routes. Only fix: 'T&P' in the details should be 'schedular'; no 2026/2027 changes found.
